evaluation.overall_comment: A highly competent and polished translation that effectively adapts a physics podcast for a Latvian-speaking audience. The text succeeds in making abstract quantum and optical concepts accessible while maintaining scientific integrity and conversational warmth. Minor terminology adjustments (notably 'divu spraugu' instead of 'divu šķēlumu') and slight phrasing refinements would elevate it to flawless technical accuracy. Overall, it meets the highest standards for educational audio translation in Latvian. Score: 18/20 - High quality with minor technical/phrasing notes.
